messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

The relation 'is a brand name of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is the commercial brand name for the drug specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
B. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
C. 'distributed from': The subject drug brand is distributed or licensed from the company specified by the object entity.
D. 'has generic name': The subject drug is sold under or known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
E. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
